scope: R4 shared Debian pool path validation
correction: Do not require a retained pool object filename to begin with its package-directory name; signed Packages indexes can contain immutable historical paths such as pool/main/s/snow-first-setup/snow-first-setup.deb.
evidence: ADC B4 independent review c45062bccc7e760fb8adab4701a8723d reproduced the path against the gpgv-verified signed stable index and the repository generator's existing layout.

correction: Filesystem tree-copy claims must distinguish preserved regular-file content, size, and complete file/directory modes from ownership, xattrs, ACLs, and timestamps; copied directory modes must be restored after creation so umask and special bits cannot alter retained content, and atomic visibility must not be described as crash durability without parent-directory fsync and recovery.
evidence: Independent review b74ddf80224eb8b6d6ab20d6a6db96b4 identified mode loss and overstated metadata/durability claims in commit 58f2763fd34da5fb0aa3dabb1f99e62f11251671.

scope: R7 generated directory and failure-injection contract
correction: MkdirAll permissions remain subject to process umask. Apply explicit fixed modes to every newly created generated directory, test complete initialize and reconcile trees under restrictive umasks, exercise failpoints on both commit paths, and keep failpoint identifiers relative to the generation root.
evidence: Independent review b74ddf80224eb8b6d6ab20d6a6db96b4 reproduced unreadable generated directories and identified reconcile coverage and unstable-key gaps in commit 0c97f1d1ef90e66b7bd9bfa0cdc0eb2f2acdf6c9.

correction: A local reconcile must not exclude the complete target suite: replace only its enumerated mutable canonical indexes and signed Release files, preserve old content-addressed by-hash objects and unmodeled suite content, and test with a package-set change so old and new by-hash paths differ.
evidence: Independent review 103307a4b82366a7149d2c9fddf84d63 reproduced silent deletion of old by-hash objects and unmodeled suite files in commit 836e215d2851e2d9d342b6dcb674a0e2c9a0333a.

correction: Test direct publication and partial recovery as separate real GPG/APT paths; return post-switch cleanup failures while retaining recoverable state; require one provider-level atomic create-if-absent operation with concurrent-conflict coverage; and apply current authorization only before a new writer attempt so completed results remain independently verifiable after revocation.
evidence: Independent review b16b74112123a3aa620964870bb0126e identified missing direct publish coverage, discarded cleanup errors, underspecified create atomicity, and completed-result replay blocked by policy revocation in commit 5df6408085299a16621d6e1cac84bcb958550eb0.

correction: Classify submission-key reuse as a conflict only when an atomic create loses and the existing bytes differ; preserve provider failures as state errors and created-object read-back failures as integrity errors.
evidence: Independent review b16b74112123a3aa620964870bb0126e identified unconditional ErrConflict wrapping for submission-pointer create and read-back failures in commit 5df6408085299a16621d6e1cac84bcb958550eb0.

correction: Once the visible output digest proves the candidate switch completed, treat its randomly named sibling as obsolete regardless of partial cleanup state; recovery must converge after interruption within RemoveAll and permit later commits without manual repair.
evidence: Independent review 6d77ef2f4d5dc2a2934738e2d7c1bfc0 reproduced a permanent recovery and commit wedge after partial obsolete-tree deletion in commit 58ba99dd15ea1bc19639ec0202b724f663170d1a.

correction: Durable requests must use the exact shared T0 producer schema and RFC 8785 canonical bytes at manifests/request/v1; do not add writer pins to the request or hash newline-terminated Go struct JSON. Derive action and Repogen executable attestations from linked provenance into the verified result, and pin a reviewed producer request as an interoperability test.
evidence: Independent review 12ffb0987874bc466e8680fab24dbb69 proved commit a06a9e6b72cfd9329ed510abcef34847ac9e2e73 rejected the independently reviewed C0 request at the shared immutable key.

correction: Exercise identity conflicts through production Generate against signed existing state, not only pure identity helpers; cover same-filename digest changes, alternate filenames for one logical identity, and metadata/filename OSVersion mismatches while proving the prior tree remains byte-identical.
evidence: Independent pre-acceptance inspection 858ef6c1e1ad72dce108dd092e7233f6 found the production normalizeAndMergePackages conflict branches uncovered in candidate e9ae8712cbfe156d9b79323e3ed6f87c74847470.

correction: An existing ext tree must be verified, merged, and staged in full even when the generic incremental flag is absent; an atomic directory switch must never turn normal mode into deletion authority for manifest-backed extensions.
evidence: Independent review e22870e9c22f5f7af365ad25e2fcad52 reproduced candidate 035daf551f4f5685d014668cfdd615f0641bf6db deleting a previously signed extension during a later non-incremental generation.

correction: Exercise the signed CLI generate path with incremental skip-duplicates and changed same-identity bytes; the test must fail if the pre-filter digest-conflict gate is disabled and must prove the prior output tree remains byte-identical.
evidence: Independent review e22870e9c22f5f7af365ad25e2fcad52 proved a one-token mutation disabled the only pre-filter digest gate while the complete prior test suite still passed.

scope: R4 shared Debian pool filename binding
correction: Permit the signed retained legacy filename only when it equals the package directory plus .deb; otherwise require the versioned filename to begin with the package directory plus underscore. Reject unrelated package filenames even when the path is signed.
evidence: Independent risk run b8237075290836be64facffca327ecd3 proved the broader historical exception accepted evil.deb and incus_7.3_amd64.deb under the snow-first-setup directory while the live retained object needs only snow-first-setup.deb.

correction: A complete reconcile-plan test must add a valid superfluous expected-prior entry without removing any required entry and assert the exact cardinality rejection; replacement and missing-entry cases do not exercise the sole guard against unmodeled prior mutable objects.
evidence: Independent review 83a0a39f3102710b4dc5df282f94bb65 removed the expected-prior cardinality guard from commit 1ecd5ed7996ff04ad898fb8785dbfbd676b70b5c and the full test suite still passed.

correction: Treat an object-store lock as liveness only unless the provider supplies fencing: never steal a held record by age, retain object-level If-None-Match/If-Match and full read-back as safety controls, and do not describe bucket-scoped R2 credentials or code allowlists as provider-enforced path permissions.
evidence: Independent C1 risk run add4f17f080ef8e91554797e28d0281d found no trustworthy R2 fencing primitive and confirmed Cloudflare token scope does not prove per-prefix enforcement.
